title: RPG Maker Game Auto-Closes at Launch

posts.author: LuciferMorningstar
posts.body:
I'm not sure if I am supposed to post this form of topic here, I apologize if I am not.
I am not a developer; I am a player having trouble launching a specific game made with RPG Maker.
Every time I click the Game.exe it opens on a black screen, thinks for about 20 seconds and then closes.
I have played many games made with RPG Maker and have never had this problem before. Normally I would inquire with the game's community but it's small and quiet and the developer seems to no longer be around.
Is there any solution to this?
I use a Windows 11 Laptop.

posts.author: kirbwarrior
posts.body: Let me know if I'm wrong, but that looks like an XP game. If you're using 11, then there's likely compatibility issues with a game from a maker that old, so I'd look into however 11 does compatibility to help play it.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:

There's really almost nothing we can do for you.
Especially if it's a specific game and other RPG Maker games work for you, the problem must be something specific to that game, and only the original developer can help.
kirbwarrior said:
that looks like an XP game. If you're using 11, then there's likely compatibility issues with a game from a maker that old
Click to expand...
I played a number of XP games on my Windows 11 system from the game jam and they ran fine.
You can certainly try running the game with compatibility mode turned on, but that's about all I can suggest.
